palette.mood: Warm tangerine office walls over deep teal desks, cream legal pads, a mint StampBot with an oxblood arm and one raspberry-magenta ink reserved for rejection and disclosure. Dry, warm, fair, never a dunk.
palette.divergence: Recorded palettes verbatim. 11-02: midnight indigo cab, sodium amber glow, electric teal stream, gunmetal counter, bone courtroom paper, magenta warning stamps. 11-01: overcast moss slope, storm slate, sulphur key, golden lantern. 10-31: sage-and-cream chart desk, cream paper, cobalt sea, brass, vermilion. 10-29: aubergine dusk depot, gold. 10-28: green-black sonar abyss. This film is a saturated tangerine daylight office with deep teal desks. The nearest value is 10-31's cream paper and brass token; the token here is gold with a hard ink keyline and sits on a teal desk or tangerine wall, never on cream paper, and the cream is limited to the Plan Sheet, legal pads and plates. Mint hero echoes 10-18's Norm only in hue; StampBot is a boxy clerk with an oxblood arm.

accent_licence.gold #D9A441: The throughline token only, with an ink keyline (#1B1230) to hold it off the tangerine wall; also the coins and badges in shot 3 as plan furniture.
accent_licence.glow #FFC36B: Light only and practical lights: the 119 dots when lit, the single lightbulb, the window bar, the pencil.
accent_licence.teal #0A4A50 desk and #0E6B73 dots: Desks, doors and the 150-dot tray. The 10,500 field sits on a rust field (#7A3A14) so teal dots read.

shape_language.grammar: ROUND people against RECTILINEAR machines and paper: StampBot's body is a soft rounded box with a round face, Characters are round-headed, the QuestionToken is scalloped-round, while the ServerMachine chatbot, the Plan Sheet, stamps' impressions, desks and chairs are hard rectangles.
shape_language.why: The thesis axis is a person deciding about a machine-drafted document. People are round, the document and the machine are rectilinear, and the picture of the turn is a round-bodied clerk pressing a rectangular disclosure into a rectangular blank.

composition.signature_shot: Shot 10 at the DISCLOSED stamp: the footnote strip, a dotted blank on the Plan Sheet since shot 1, finishes typing, StampBot's magenta DISCLOSED lands with a recoil, the single lightbulb beside the strip lights for the first and only time and its warm practical becomes the key on the strip, while the window bar crosses once.
